note: Years 7-10 curriculum spine, drafted for Andrew to trim (Q20). buildMode kana = assemble each word from kana tiles (script fluency: rendaku, sokuon, small kana, long vowels). buildMode kanji = assemble key kanji from parts in position, Factory-style. prior = the unit a gap check reaches back to.

units.title: はじめまして · First Meetings
units.blurb: Your first real conversations: hello and goodbye at the right time of day, your name, your age, please and thank you.

gram.label: あいさつ · greetings that fit the moment
gram.why: おはよう before school, こんにちは after lunch, さようなら at the gate. Each greeting has its hour.

gram.label: 〜です · saying who you are
gram.why: The first frame: なまえは ______です。______さいです。

gram.label: かず · numbers you own
gram.why: Your age, your class, how many. Numbers carry your first facts.

units.title: かぞくとペット · Family and Pets
units.topic: Family members and animals at home
units.blurb: The people and animals at your place: who they are, how many there are, and the words Japanese uses for YOUR family versus someone else's.

gram.label: 〜がいます · who is at home
gram.why: People and pets take います: あねが います。いぬも います。

gram.label: は・が・も · pointing at people
gram.why: は sets the topic, が counts them, も adds the dog.

gram.label: にん・ひき · counting people and pets
gram.why: Japanese counts people with にん and small animals with ひき. The counter is part of the fact.

units.title: すきなもの · Things I Like
units.topic: Likes and dislikes: food, colours, hobbies
units.blurb: The sentence that opens every friendship: what you like, what you do not, and asking someone else theirs.

gram.label: すき・きらい · likes as sentences
gram.why: ______が すきです。______は ちょっと…。Liking is a です sentence, not a verb.

gram.label: が・は · what the liking sticks to
gram.why: The liked thing takes が. The thing you pass over takes は.

gram.label: か・ね · asking and agreeing
gram.why: すきですか。turns it into a question; すきですね。shares it.

units.title: がっこうのいちにち · A School Day
units.blurb: Your timetable in Japanese: subjects, the days of the week, what time things start, and what you think of Monday.

gram.label: じかん · clock times and days
gram.why: 〜じ、〜ようび: the timetable is numbers wearing uniforms.

gram.label: に・で · when and where
gram.why: Times take に: くじに はじまります。Places of doing take で.

gram.label: 〜ます · school verbs, politely
gram.why: べんきょうします、はじまります: the ます ending is school register.

units.title: まいにちのせいかつ · Daily Routines and Time
units.blurb: Your whole day as a chain of verbs: getting up, eating, going, coming home, sleeping, and the times that pin each one down.

gram.label: 〜ます・〜ました · doing and did
gram.why: おきます、たべます、ねます: the routine verbs, present and past.

gram.label: じこく · times through the day
gram.why: しちじに おきます。The に after a time is the nail the day hangs on.

gram.label: ます-stem · the verb's working part
gram.why: Take off ます and the stem is what everything later builds on.

units.title: たべものとかいもの · Food and Shopping
units.blurb: Eating out and buying things: menus, prices in yen, ordering politely, and the counters that come with food.

gram.label: 〜てください · asking for things
gram.why: みせてください、ください: the shop runs on polite requests.

gram.label: ねだん · prices and big numbers
gram.why: ひゃく、せん、まん: yen prices make big numbers real.

gram.label: どのぐらい · how much, how many
gram.why: Amounts and comparisons start here: もっと、たくさん、ちょっと.

units.title: しゅみとスポーツ · Hobbies and Sport
units.topic: Hobbies, sport and inviting a friend
units.blurb: What you do for fun and how to invite someone along: playing, watching, practising, and ませんか, the sentence that makes plans.

gram.label: 〜ませんか・〜ましょう · inviting
gram.why: いっしょに しませんか。しましょう!: invitations are stem work.

gram.label: を・で · what you play, where
gram.why: テニスを します。こうえんで します。The particles carry the plan.

gram.label: ね・よ · keeping the chat going
gram.why: じょうずですね。たのしいですよ。Agreement and news, one syllable each.

units.title: わたしのまちとしゅうまつ · My Town and Weekends
units.topic: Places in town, going places, weekend plans
units.blurb: Your town as a map of verbs: places you go, how you get there, and what last weekend actually looked like.

gram.label: に・へ・で · going and doing
gram.why: としょかんに いきます。バスで いきます。Movement is particle work.

gram.label: 〜ました · the weekend in past tense
gram.why: どこに いきましたか。The weekend question every Monday.

gram.label: そして・それから · chaining the day
gram.why: Went here, then there: the day joins up with connectives.

units.title: まちをあるく · Getting Around Town
units.blurb: Finding your way: stations and streets, asking where things are, understanding the answer, and your first kanji built from their parts.

gram.label: 〜てください · directions as requests
gram.why: まっすぐ いってください。みぎに まがってください。Directions are て-form.

gram.label: まで・から · from here to there
gram.why: えきから みせまで: the route lives between から and まで.

gram.label: よむ · signs and short texts
gram.why: Town is full of short reading: signs, maps, notices.

units.title: たべることとけんこう · Food and Health
units.topic: Meals, taste, cooking and healthy habits
units.blurb: What you eat and what it does for you: taste words, cooking, meals through the day, and saying what is good for you.

gram.label: くらべる · more, less, too much
gram.why: やさいのほうが けんこうに いいです: food talk is comparison talk.

gram.label: 〜て · cooking as a chain
gram.why: きって、いためて、たべます: recipes are て-form trains.

gram.label: きゅうしょくのことば · the food word pool
gram.why: The hub's school-lunch vocabulary set backs this whole unit.

units.title: てんきときせつ · Weather, Seasons and Festivals
units.topic: Weather, the four seasons and seasonal events
units.blurb: The sky and the calendar: weather words, the four seasons and what each one brings, from summer fireworks to autumn leaves.

gram.label: から・ので · because it is hot
gram.why: あついから、うみに いきます。Weather is the classic reason-giver.

gram.label: いちばん · the superlative season
gram.why: ふゆが いちばん すきです: seasons invite ranking.

gram.label: 〜ました · the festival you went to
gram.why: はなびを みました: seasonal events live in the past tense.

units.title: がっこうせいかつ · School Life Here and in Japan
units.topic: School life, clubs and comparing schools
units.blurb: School on both sides of the equator: subjects and clubs, what Japanese schools do differently, and reading about a school day that is not yours.

gram.label: じしょ形 · the plain form arrives
gram.why: Friends at school do not speak in ます. The plain form is the club-room register.

gram.label: でも・が · same but different
gram.why: Comparing schools needs contrast: にほんでは…でも、ここでは…

gram.label: よむ · longer school texts
gram.why: The reading pool's school texts back this unit's comparisons.

units.title: じぶんをかたる · Talking About Yourself
units.blurb: The self-introduction grown up: not just name and age but where you are from, what you are good at, and the story that makes it yours. Pairs with the Level Up Wall.

gram.label: 〜で、〜です · stacking who you are
gram.why: じゅうごさいで、オーストラリアじんです: identity facts chain with で.

gram.label: ふつう体 · plain form fluency
gram.why: Talking ABOUT yourself needs plain-form clauses inside polite sentences.

gram.label: よ・ね・かな · voice and stance
gram.why: The particles that make a self-introduction sound like a person.

units.title: たびのじゅんび · Planning a Trip
units.blurb: A trip before it happens: where to stay, what to book, waiting and buying and packing, and the たら that turns plans into sentences.

gram.label: 〜てから · the itinerary in order
gram.why: チェックインしてから、まちを あるきます: itineraries are sequenced て-forms.

gram.label: 〜たら · if the weather holds
gram.why: はれたら、やまに いきます: every plan has a たら inside it.

gram.label: 〜に行く · travelling on purpose
gram.why: おんせんに はいりに いく: the stem plus に行く is why you travel.

units.title: メディアのせかい · The World of Media
units.topic: Music, shows, articles and what you follow
units.blurb: What you watch, read and listen to: songs and programmes, articles and posts, and saying what something is about and why you follow it.

gram.label: 〜そうです · what you heard
gram.why: あたらしい ばんぐみが はじまるそうです: media talk is reported talk.

gram.label: 〜のが好き · liking a doing
gram.why: うたを きくのが すきです: the の turns watching into a thing you can like.

gram.label: くらべる · better than the book
gram.why: えいがより ほんのほうが おもしろいです: media invites ranking.

units.title: はたらくみらい · Work and the Future
units.topic: Part-time work, jobs and plans after school
units.blurb: Work as a place your Japanese is going: busy days, part-time jobs, what you can do, and the future you are aiming at. Bridges straight into VCE.

gram.label: ことができる · what you can do
gram.why: にほんごで でんわに でることが できます: the CV sentence.

gram.label: 〜たら · after graduating
gram.why: そつぎょうしたら…: the future hangs on たら.

gram.label: なければ · what work demands
gram.why: はやく おきなければ なりません: obligation enters with work.
